subject: general
question: What does the abbreviation SAARC stand for?

options.text: South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation

solution:
The correct answer is__** South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **South Asian Association of Regional Cooperation** (SAARC) was created in 1985.
 
• There are eight member countries in SAARC that are **Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Nepal, Maldives, Pakistan and Sri Lanka.**
 
• The Secretariat of the Association was set up in Kathmandu, Nepal, on 17 January 1987. 
 
• The main motive of SAARC is to **place regional cooperation on a hard foundation**, quicken the pace of social and economic development of the countries, and further the** cause of peace, progress and stability in the region.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Countries of SAARC:-
 
 
• ​Afghanistan. 
 
• Bangladesh.
 
• Bhutan.
 
• India.
 
• Maldives.
 
• Nepal.
 
• Pakistan
 
• Sri-Lanka
